Damn I got lucky, I just tried to search videos of eye creams and one of my fav korean skincare youtubers posted video about it, thank you☺️

Thanks for the clear breakdown! One thing I’d like to add is that eye creams can work very differently depending on their purpose. Personally, I’ve had a good experience with VT PDRN Eye Lifter in terms of hydration and comfort around the eye area.

Beauty of joseon is amazing for dark circles. It takes a bit of time to work which is expected from retinal cream but after about 3 months of continuous use I have seen amazing difference to my dark circles
You should have mentioned which are best for dark circles
I like how she always burst our bubble then give us great reviews

Okay, personally the Beauty of Joseon Retinol eye cream is my favorite retinal product because if how light it is.  I'm really sensitive to sensations on my skin, to the point where I can't stand most products with a traditional "lotion" type texture unless they absorb super fast.  While I would still prefer a more gel-like texture, the Beauty of Joseon cream absorbs quickly enough that it doesn't bother me for long, and I don't really feel it all once it's absorbed.  So, while it might not be the most potent retinal, it's still the one I've found the most pleasant to use, and thus it's my favorite

I love the beauty of Joseon eye cream for my whole face and I’m over 40 . I have sensitive skin rosacea, acne prone oily skin( but dehydrated) So far it’s the only retinal product that won’t immediately give me a damaged skin barrier. Even with how light it is I need to baby my skin in between using it. with hydrating and moisturizing products. If you have rosacea and acne prone skin try using this eye cream as an active for your entire face sandwiched between a serum with no actives just nourishing ingredients ( I like shesiedo ultamate) and  panthenol ceramide rich Non- comedogenic cream on top( I like prequel half and half) . 💝 Next day rinse your face and put cooling gentle toner pads. I like the abib heart leaf with a fan hitting my face. The cooling will relieve any inflammation or irritation from the night before. Rosacea is often irritated by things that cause inflammation or heat within the skin. So always wear sunscreen( I like mung bean) since I have a sensitivity to CICA. Hope this helps someone💕💕💕
